campaign.title: The Long March
campaign.premise: A mobile fortress crosses a ruined continent carrying people, tools, and the last working promises between settlements.
campaign.player_role: The newly appointed marchmaster responsible for keeping the fortress moving and useful.
campaign.regional_objective: Reach the Meridian Refuge before the ash season closes the eastern passes.

chapters.title: The Road Out
chapters.summary: Learn the chassis, complete a first contract, and discover that every useful module creates a dependency.
chapters.player_question: Can this fortress move without becoming helpless?

chapters.title: The Broken Relay
chapters.summary: A communications line fails, forcing a choice between signal range, armor, and movement speed.
chapters.player_question: What is a fortress worth if it cannot hear the road?

chapters.title: The Ash Meridian
chapters.summary: Storms and Burrowers attack the lower hull, making recovery and redundant systems essential.
chapters.player_question: How much redundancy can the fortress afford?

chapters.title: The Weight of Shelter
chapters.summary: The fortress takes on refugees and must decide whether cargo, armor, or mobility matters most.
chapters.player_question: What does the machine owe the people inside it?

chapters.title: The Last March
chapters.summary: The fortress faces the final road, where its accumulated dependencies and relationships are tested together.
chapters.player_question: Did we build a machine that can survive without one perfect part?

campaign.map_model: authored branching node map with FTL-like forward visibility and a regional closure-pressure clock

pressure_clock.guarantee: never remove the only viable recovery route

locations.name: Ashgate Depot
locations.story_function: Introduces the fortress, contracts, refits, and the cost of being stationary.
locations.visual_motif: Canvas roofs, black rails, amber signal lamps, and chalked repair diagrams.

locations.name: Meridian Refuge
locations.story_function: Represents the future network the fortress is trying to preserve.
locations.visual_motif: White stone terraces, windbreak cloth, and old fortress plates reused as roofs.

locations.name: Broken Relay
locations.story_function: Makes information and signal dependencies physically visible.
locations.visual_motif: A leaning mast, snapped cable, and faded blue route markers.

locations.name: Meridian Pass
locations.story_function: Tests movement, storm preparation, and lower-hull redundancy.
locations.visual_motif: Pale ash dunes, half-buried road ribs, and red warning pennants.

locations.name: Rill Crossing
locations.story_function: Offers the first safe-road versus shortcut decision.
locations.visual_motif: Broken rail bridge, red pennants, and water wheels.

locations.name: The Soot Orchard
locations.story_function: Provides fuel and a lesson in cargo opportunity cost.
locations.visual_motif: Blackened trees, hanging tools, and warm ash.

locations.name: Morrowline Camp
locations.story_function: Makes convoy contracts and refugee capacity visible.
locations.visual_motif: Canvas wagons, cooking fires, and portable signal flags.

locations.name: Red Wheel Toll Bridge
locations.story_function: Turns Red Wheel pressure into a visible choice between payment and resistance.
locations.visual_motif: A plated toll gantry, chained wagons, and red wheel marks painted over old road signs.

locations.name: Lower Ash Road
locations.story_function: Tests whether the fortress prepared for Burrowers before the final gate.
locations.visual_motif: A sunken service road, cracked ash crust, and iron stakes marking old collapses.

locations.name: Dry Cistern Cut
locations.story_function: Tests whether a maintained sustain system earns and survives its shorter road.
locations.visual_motif: Collapsed cistern mouths, chalk-white channels, and strips of storm cloth tied to buried pipes.

locations.name: Signal Causeway
locations.story_function: Rewards signal preparation and Iven Pell while exposing roof-mounted systems.
locations.visual_motif: A raised road of relay pylons disappearing into a wall of pale ash.

locations.name: Cinder Quarry
locations.story_function: Offers a mixed cargo-and-lower-hull contact in exchange for guaranteed field repair before Meridian Pass.
locations.visual_motif: Terraced black cuts, abandoned plate stacks, and quarry warning lamps above a buried haul road.

locations.name: Lantern Quay
locations.story_function: Introduces water, divers, and fragile cargo.
locations.visual_motif: Floating walkways, blue lamps, and half-submerged towers.

locations.name: The Dry Archive
locations.story_function: Turns map knowledge and relay trust into route choices.
locations.visual_motif: Salt-white stacks, cable reels, and guarded reading rooms.

locations.name: Blackkiln
locations.story_function: Offers powerful heat tools at the price of labor and fuel.
locations.visual_motif: Basalt chimneys, orange windows, and chain lifts.

locations.name: The Switchback Commune
locations.story_function: Offers shelter and safe routes instead of maximum speed.
locations.visual_motif: Terraced workshops, rope bridges, and windbreak cloth.

locations.name: Saltglass Haven
locations.story_function: Tests visibility, trust, and supply planning on open ground.
locations.visual_motif: Mirrored towers, cisterns, and long blue shadows.

factions.name: The March Settlements
factions.public_position: A moving network is worth more than any one fortified place.
factions.private_pressure: Each settlement wants the fortress to carry its burden first.
factions.content_rule: Settlement support should improve options while creating obligations, never become a passive bonus.

factions.name: Road Raider Companies
factions.public_position: The road belongs to whoever can keep it.
factions.private_pressure: Some companies are predators; others are displaced convoy crews.
factions.content_rule: Raider choices should trade cargo safety against speed, visibility, and political cost.

factions.name: The Relay Keepers
factions.public_position: Information is infrastructure and should not be owned by one fortress.
factions.private_pressure: They are willing to let a route fail to preserve a larger warning network.
factions.content_rule: Relay choices should improve knowledge while asking the player to protect or share it.

characters.name: Mara Flint
characters.motivation: Keep every repairable machine alive long enough to matter.
characters.strength: Improves workshop recovery and temporary repairs.
characters.fear: A fortress that discards people and parts before trying to repair them.
characters.relationship_hook: Mara respects controlled sacrifice but hates waste disguised as efficiency.

characters.name: Iven Pell
characters.motivation: Make the road legible enough that people can choose danger knowingly.
characters.strength: Improves threat forecasts and signal-linked interventions.
characters.fear: A warning that arrives after the decision is already made.
characters.relationship_hook: Iven wants reports shared even when secrecy would make the fortress safer.

characters.name: Sela Vonn
characters.motivation: Reach settlements before the road closes, even if the fortress arrives damaged.
characters.strength: Reduces travel time and improves route-posture choices.
characters.fear: Losing a day while people wait at the next shelter.
characters.relationship_hook: Sela pushes for speed until the crew shows her the true repair cost.

characters.name: Eda Rook
characters.motivation: Turn the Red Wheel away from predation.
characters.strength: Negotiates raider passes and identifies ambush patterns.
characters.relationship_hook: Recruiting Eda improves convoy contracts but lowers trust with raider victims.

characters.name: Brother Caldus
characters.motivation: Keep the old records from becoming weapons.
characters.strength: Identifies relics and detects disturbed vaults.
characters.relationship_hook: Caldus protects knowledge but makes the fortress a target for industrial factions.

characters.name: Jun Vey
characters.motivation: Carry warnings faster than the ash season.
characters.strength: Moves information between settlements when the fortress stops.
characters.fear: Being left behind by a faster plan.
characters.relationship_hook: Jun unlocks evacuation choices but raises the human cost of dangerous shortcuts.

characters.name: Anika Sorn
characters.motivation: Make the fortress capable of becoming a shelter.
characters.strength: Creates efficient armor layouts and firebreaks.
characters.fear: A machine optimized only for velocity.
characters.relationship_hook: Anika improves protection but disputes every overloaded speed build.

characters.name: Ravel Kest
characters.motivation: Prove that a fortress can outrun every obligation.
characters.strength: Creates tempting speed alliances and shortcut access.
characters.fear: Arriving first with nobody left to save.
characters.relationship_hook: Ravel mirrors a pure-mobility strategy and can become ally or final rival.

events.title: A Machine That Still Answers
events.setup: The fortress has fuel for one departure and enough parts for one serious repair. The depot offers three ways to make it roadworthy.

choices.label: Spend parts on the engine.
choices.visible_result: The fortress moves reliably, but one cargo rack is removed for the repair rig.

choices.label: Plate the forward hull.
choices.visible_result: The fortress can take a hit, but the first route will be slower.

choices.label: Leave with the parts in the hold.
choices.visible_result: You preserve future flexibility and accept that the first road will expose the unfinished machine.

events.title: The Parts Wagon Promise
events.setup: Morrowline's last parts wagon is leaving Ashgate under the fortress's shadow. Guarding it will draw a committed raider attack on the camp approach.

choices.label: Guard the parts wagon to Morrowline.
choices.visible_result: The convoy approach becomes harder, but safe arrival pays for a meaningful recovery.

choices.label: Travel without the convoy obligation.
choices.visible_result: The fortress keeps its freedom of movement and gives up the contract reward.

events.title: The Toll of Being Large
events.setup: A displaced convoy crew approaches under a stolen banner. They know exactly which exterior mount looks unprotected.

choices.label: Power the exterior gun and warn them off.
choices.visible_result: The raiders withdraw, but the fortress broadcasts its firing range.

choices.label: Give up a low-value cargo crate.
choices.visible_result: The convoy passes without violence, and word spreads that the fortress can be negotiated with.

choices.label: Rush the exposed shortcut.
choices.visible_result: You escape the encounter quickly, but the engine now needs attention.

events.title: The Red Wheel Ledger
events.setup: The toll captain offers a quiet crossing for coin. Breaking the post helps later convoys but brings the wider blockade closer.

choices.label: Pay 10 Ashmarks.
choices.visible_result: The blockade delays pursuit and keeps the seized road coin.

choices.label: Break the toll post.
choices.visible_result: The road opens for later convoys, and the rest of the Red Wheel begins closing in.

events.title: The Silence Between Lamps
events.setup: The relay mast has gone dark. Iven can restore a weak signal, or the fortress can travel blind and keep its power for the engine.

choices.label: Power the relay coil.
choices.visible_result: The next route forecast becomes clearer, but the fortress begins the crossing with less reserve.

choices.label: Broadcast the relay location to nearby settlements.
choices.visible_result: Help arrives later, but the signal becomes a target.

choices.label: Keep the fortress dark and leave.
choices.visible_result: The fortress is harder to find and harder to prepare.

events.title: The Sky Comes Down
events.setup: A wall of ash is crossing the pass. The fortress can slow, seal, or keep its exposed equipment active to maintain a route signal.

choices.label: Seal the exterior mounts and wait.
choices.visible_result: The fortress loses time but reaches the pass with its exposed systems intact.

choices.label: Keep moving through the ash.
choices.visible_result: The fortress keeps its schedule and emerges with multiple systems strained.

choices.label: Drop the relay mast and protect the engine.
choices.visible_result: The fortress preserves movement but abandons the warning network behind it.

events.title: The Orchard Burns
events.setup: Fuel lies under a burning orchard, but rescuing the workers will cost time.

choices.label: Recover the fuel first.
choices.visible_result: The fortress gains range but leaves the orchard community without help.

choices.label: Rescue the workers.
choices.visible_result: The fortress loses time and gains a future recruit lead.

events.title: A Road With Too Many Wagons
events.setup: The convoy can move only if the fortress gives up speed or cargo space.

choices.label: Take the convoy through.
choices.visible_result: The convoy survives and the next route is slower.

choices.label: Leave before the route closes.
choices.visible_result: The fortress keeps its schedule and loses a future shelter ally.

events.title: The Archive’s Door
events.setup: The Relay Keepers will share a map only if the fortress agrees to broadcast its warnings.

choices.label: Broadcast the warning network.
choices.visible_result: Future forecasts improve, but the fortress becomes easier to locate.

choices.label: Keep the route private.
choices.visible_result: The next crossing is quieter, but other settlements remain uninformed.

events.title: The Forge Without a Roof
events.setup: Mara Flint has kept the convoy's axles moving from an open repair bench and asks for a staffed workshop aboard the fortress.

choices.label: Bring Mara aboard.
choices.visible_result: Mara occupies the specialist berth and every operational workshop repair restores one additional durability.

choices.label: Leave Mara with Morrowline.
choices.visible_result: The berth remains open, but the fortress gains no repair bonus or forge-core decision.

events.title: One Sound Core
events.setup: One intact forge core can rebuild the weakest installed system or become permanent bracing for refugee space.

choices.label: Rebuild the weakest installed system.
choices.visible_result: The named system is restored immediately, but the blockade advances during the careful repair.

choices.label: Brace the Refugee Bunk.
choices.visible_result: The bunk gains persistent protection, but no damaged system is restored at Morrowline.

events.title: What Held
events.setup: Mara checks the earlier workbench commitment against the system or shelter space that actually survived the road.

choices.label: Record that the repair held.
choices.visible_result: The repaired system held through the fourth road, avoiding another roadside delay.

choices.label: Record that the repair failed.
choices.visible_result: The repaired system failed before the check and grants no hidden pressure recovery.

choices.label: Record that the berth held.
choices.visible_result: The braced Refugee Bunk remained usable and proves the fortress kept space for people.

choices.label: Record that the berth failed.
choices.visible_result: The bunk was not operational at the later check and grants no hidden trust or Shelter gain.

events.title: The Boiler's Second Heartbeat
events.trigger: road_arrival and damaged_engine_operational and repair_system_ready and cooldown_clear
events.setup: A second rhythm answers the engine stroke. The fortress can stop for the workshop or ask the damaged bearing to carry the road.

choices.label: Stop and inspect the engine.
choices.visible_result: The engine recovers one durability while the blockade gains a day.

choices.label: Keep the marching cadence.
choices.visible_result: The fortress gains distance by spending visible engine condition.

events.title: The Lift Chain Sings
events.trigger: road_arrival and ammunition_lift_operational and weapon_operational and cooldown_clear
events.setup: The Ammunition Lift vibrates under a full road load. A proper brace costs coin; carrying the load strains the weapon dependency.

choices.label: Fit a proper chain brace.
choices.visible_result: The paid brace reduces future route risk without hiding its cost.

choices.label: Carry the load to the next stop.
choices.visible_result: The column gains distance while its ammunition dependency visibly degrades.

events.title: The Last Dry Room
events.trigger: arrival and refuge_operational and parts_operational and not_previously_resolved
events.setup: One sealed compartment can keep the repair stock dry or shelter the families riding beside it, but not both.

choices.label: Give the room to the families.
choices.visible_result: The fortress preserves shelter by exposing a physical repair dependency.

choices.label: Keep the parts dry.
choices.visible_result: The weakest system recovers while the people denied the room remember the decision.

events.title: The Miller With a Broken Wheel
events.setup: A miller offers sealed fuel tins if the fortress lends its bench and fitter. The repair is small; the stopped column is not.

choices.label: Lend the workshop bench.
choices.visible_result: The miller pays in fuel and trust while the fortress gives up time and workshop condition.

choices.label: Keep the column moving.
choices.visible_result: The fortress keeps its distance from the blockade and leaves the miller behind.

endings.title: The Road Keeps Moving
endings.summary: The fortress arrives not as a lone survivor but as the first moving link in a repaired network.
endings.crew_note: Iven broadcasts the route. Mara starts a workshop under the refuge terraces.

endings.title: The Fortress Stays
endings.summary: The fortress reaches the refuge slowly and becomes a permanent shelter, workshop, and defensive anchor.
endings.crew_note: Sela gives up the road. Mara says a machine can have a second life.

endings.title: The Last Convoy Through
endings.summary: The fortress remains scarred but fast, carrying the final tools and people through before the pass closes.
endings.crew_note: Sela marks the route in red. Iven refuses to call it safe.

endings.title: Still Answering
endings.summary: The fortress reaches the refuge missing pieces but carrying enough people and knowledge to begin again.
endings.crew_note: Mara hangs the broken parts above the workshop door so nobody calls survival effortless.

implemented_journey_slice.title: The Road Out
implemented_journey_slice.player_question: Can the fortress keep a contract, read a closing map, recover at Morrowline, and survive five linked encounters?

map_rules.rule: Each chapter presents two or three connected choices from deterministic node templates.
Known, forecast, and unscouted nodes reveal progressively more information.
A visible regional clock changes or closes optional nodes without deleting the only viable recovery path.
Every boss approach and failed encounter retains a settlement, camp, or lower-value route.
Every shortcut saves at least one visible resource while increasing a visible risk.
